Grizz.when_to_use: Beginner content, learning scenarios, asking questions, taking notes, approachable moments
Grizz.personality_in_images: Patient, curious, eager to learn, friendly, humble
Grizz.typical_poses: Taking notes, studying charts, practicing on demo account, receiving mentorship
Grizz.typical_expressions: Friendly smile, curious look, focused concentration, excitement when learning

Toro.when_to_use: Competitive scenarios, strategic analysis, intermediate skill demonstrations, discipline
Toro.personality_in_images: Disciplined, strategic, competitive, focused, resilient, professional
Toro.typical_poses: Power stance (arms crossed), analyzing multiple charts, forward-leaning intensity, fist pump victory
Toro.typical_expressions: Intense focus, competitive confidence, determination, respectful acknowledgment

Jet.when_to_use: Elite performance, precision execution, advanced strategies, high-stakes moments
Jet.personality_in_images: Lightning-fast, surgical precision, hyper-focused, calm under pressure, elite
Jet.typical_poses: Perched alert stance, swift execution movements, targeting precision, poised to strike
Jet.typical_expressions: Cool calm focus, predatory precision, subtle satisfaction, intense concentration

Oran.when_to_use: Teaching moments, mentorship, community building, explaining concepts, supportive scenarios
Oran.personality_in_images: Wise, patient, supportive, encouraging, experienced, community-focused
Oran.typical_poses: Gesturing to explain, hand on student's shoulder, presenting to group, holding educational materials
Oran.typical_expressions: Warm smile, patient encouragement, knowing look, supportive nod

ui_elements: Trading charts (candlesticks, line charts, bar charts)
